block.title: Zone D enemies: portrait descent, a cone's eruption column full of wisps rising past the camera
block.positive: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired concept rendering, bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, vertical poster composition looking down a lava chimney, subtle CRT scanline glow. A deep vertical shaft in a molten fortress-world: walls of stacked black basalt plates veined with lava light from dark ember red to tangerine narrow toward a bright crater lake at the bottom of the frame, falling lava droplets arcing like slow gold fireflies. Dominating the lower third, a giant MAGMA CONE seen from above and behind, its terraced rock body ringed with glowing seams, crater aimed at the shaft mouth, mid-burp — a thick column of heat and pink-red molten shot climbing the whole height of the image. Riding that column upward, a dozen EMBER WISPS scatter like sparks from a firework: small feral flames with molten-gold cores, ragged orange-red tongues, long sparking tails, some drifting out toward the camera past the rock ledges. Far above at the top edge, a tiny steel-blue dart fighter with cyan canopy and orange engine glow crosses the shaft mouth in silhouette, unawares, framed by two dark navy jaws of stone. The whole scene lit from below by the eruption, hard orange rim-light on every rock edge, deep navy shadow wells in the wall cracks.

block.notes: Vertical chimney = Zone D's shaft set-pieces turned into a poster. The wisps riding the eruption column foreshadow the boss CINDER BASTION's arena without depicting it — keep the cone clearly smaller than a boss, a turret, not a fortress. Up-lighting gives the dramatic rim contrast.
